question: In basketball, how many points are awarded when a basket is scored from outside the 6.25-metre line?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Three points**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **basketball**, the scoring system is divided into different point categories based on the location from where the shot is taken.
 
• A basket scored from outside the **6.25-meter line** (also known as the three-point line) is awarded **three points**.
